This algo trading bot won 94% of its trades. 2,299 trades. Seven years of data.
And it still finished behind doing nothing at all.

every indicator it uses, every rule it follows, and the one hand-written rule
that manufactures that 94% win rate.

Then we run it through a 7-year backtest, let AI interrogate all 2,299 trades,
and deliberately try to break it.

This is Strategy 01 of 100. We don't just backtest strategies. We try to break them.
